style: a cinematic, photoreal night-time automotive commercial shot, high contrast, deep near-black shadows with orange rim light, no text, no logos
setting: a dark wet runway at night with small orange edge lights

subjects.desc: a sleek unbranded electric hypercar, dark grey with orange rim light, no badges or text

shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.
shots.action: The car hovers about one metre above the runway on four bright white jets of compressed air; the jets sputter and stop, the car drops straight down and lands on its wheels with a small bounce, and the white mist slowly drifts away.

soundscape: A loud hiss of compressed air that sputters out, a heavy thump as the car lands, then quiet dripping on the wet runway.
